Ava - People Ops: Quick Q — how do we handle 401k match for hires who start after the payroll cutoff? Also HSA enrollment timing for same-day hires?
Devon - Engineering: Is the employer match applied per-paycheck or monthly? :thinking:
Sam - Payroll: We match per-paycheck. Payroll cutoff is the 20th of each month for semimonthly runs. If hire is after cutoff, their first paycheck is next cycle, and we only match on paychecks where there's employee deferral.
Ava - People Ops: So if they elect 5% on day 3 but hire date was 22nd, do we miss the match for that first partial period?
Sam - Payroll: If deferral is set before the first payroll run for that employee, match will apply on that paycheck. If not, we can do a retro match as an exception (needs manager + People Ops sign-off and a payroll adjustment).
Sam - Payroll: Retro match process (short):
```
1) People Ops approval email
2) Payroll creates adjustment: type=employer_401k_match, amount=calculated_match, effective_date=original_pay_date
3) Run ad-hoc contribution to recordkeeper
```
Maya - Benefits Admin: Note on recordkeeper side — retro contributions may need a manual vendor ticket and could take 5-7 business days to post. If the employee is moving money from a prior 401k, we need the rollover paperwork before we can allocate funds.
Liam - New Hire: Related Q — for HSA, if I enroll on hire day, when do pre-tax deductions start? I don't want to miss employer HSA contributions.
BenefitsBot: HSA rules -> contributions start with the first payroll after enrollment is processed by Benefits team. Employer contributions are tied to payroll schedule, not calendar hire date. FSA elections are different: they must be elected during OE or QLE and are prorated, and FSAs can't be rolled between vendors.
Maya - Benefits Admin: For HSA rollovers from prior trustee: employees can roll their old HSA to our trustee (partner vendor). They must provide latest statement + account number. For FSA, no rollovers; leave with old plan or request reimbursement before terminating.
Devon - Engineering: Any forms I need to tell new hires to fill immediately?
Ava - People Ops: Please have them complete: I-9, direct deposit, 401k deferral election (within Day 1 packet link: https://redwood.internal/hr/onboarding), and benefits enrollment within 30 days. If they want the match on first check, set the 401k election before payroll cut.
Sam - Payroll: I'll add a calendar reminder for onboarding coordinators: "Confirm 401k election before first payroll run". I'll also flag any retro match requests.
Liam - New Hire: Thanks all — that helps. :thumbsup:
Ava - People Ops: Thanks team — filing notes. If anyone needs the payroll cutoff table I'll post it in #people-ops-resources.
